paite: TOUPA' inn ah hoh ni, ka kianga achih lai un ka kipak hi.
heading: David La / Jerusalem Phatna

paite: Jerusalem aw, na kulh kongkhak sung ah ka khete uh adingh hi.
Jerusalem, khopi bang a lam kiptak a gawmkhawm,
TOUPA min phat ding in huai ah namte apaitou ua, TOUPA namte ngei, Israelte kiang a thu theihsakna ding in.
Huai ah lah vaihawmna a ding in laltutphahte tun ahi ngal a, David inkuanpihte laltutphahte.
Jerusalem khamuanna ding in ngetsak un; nang hon deihte anavak uhi.
Na kulh sungte ah khamuanna om henla, na inpite ah navakna om hen.
Ka unaute leh ka lawmte ziak in, na sung ah khamuanna om hen, ka chi ding hi.
TOUPA i Pathian inn ziak in na hoihna ding ka zong ding.
